basic_info.description: Sold in conjunction with the adjoining 3-unit parcel for total of 6-units. (1732-1736 Page Street, MLS# 425060364 ). Sale price is for 6-unit building on combined parcels.     An extraordinary investment opportunity in the heart of Haight Ashbury: the building features six oversized 4BD/1BA flats spanning two adjoining parcels, just steps from the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park. This 12,750 sq ft building features classic San Francisco charm, a combined 6,872 sq ft lot, and one unit delivered vacant at close. With significant long-term upside, strong rental demand, and possible ADU expansion potential (buyer to verify), 1732-1736 and 1738-1742 Page Street is a rare chance to secure a legacy asset in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods.
